title: Elise Wedding 10/15/11
author: madwire
excerpt: The wedding went great.  We were set up and ready to go a full hour before the guests began to arrive.  Many requests made throughout the night that we were able to do for the guests.  Everyone was doing the electric slide and having a great time!
